🍭 Upcoming - Soda shop event is on the way! It will be added sometime around the beginning of November and add a bunch of new pets, decorations, and the limited sweet mutation!

9/25/26
🎃 Halloween update has been added! Find limited time pets and decorations!

🌲 Welcome to Pet Forest! 🐾

Collect the rarest pets and show them off in your base! Can you get them all?

🐱 How to play:
Get pets from trees and plants
Put the pets in your base to generate money
Finally, use the money to get better pets!

🐰 What we offer:
Variety of biomes, trees and pets
Decoration system for your base
Recipe tracking + crafting
Unique pet mutations
Chromatic pets
Time limited mythical pets
Many save slots for your pets
Frequent events and update
Admin abuse every two weeks
